title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.3 - Server Banner Update
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.3 is now available for download.
Open.mp servers can now display custom banners in the server list and Server Information dashboard.
Server banners support PNG, JPG, WebP, and animated GIF using a direct HTTPS image URL in the open.mp config.json banners section.
Recommended server banner size is 2048 x 682 pixels with an approximately 3:1 aspect ratio.
Selected-server status, ping, and player counts now refresh every second using lightweight queries with safer rate limiting.
Every server card now includes a copy-address action with visible clipboard confirmation.
Open the official release page to download and install the latest MSI.
